Mysteries.Title:
The First Sorrowful Mystery

The Agony of Jesus
Mysteries.SubTitle: Obedience

Meditation.text: Jesus and His Apostles go to Gethsemane to pray.
With Peter, James and John, He enters the olive grove.
“My soul is sorrowful unto death.”
“Father, if it be Thy will, let this cup pass from Me.”
“Yet, not My will, but Thine be done.”
“Could you not watch one hour with Me?”
“Watch and pray that you enter not into temptation.”
Judas betrays Jesus with a kiss.
“Having seized Jesus, they led Him away to the high priest’s house.”
His disciples abandon Him.

Mysteries.Title:
The Second Sorrowful Mystery

Jesus is scourged
Mysteries.SubTitle: Love Others

Meditation.text: Before the high priest Annas, one of the guards strikes Jesus in the face.
Annas sends Jesus, bound, to the high priest Caiphas.
They sought false witnesses against Jesus that they might put Him to death.
Peter denies three times that he is a disciple of Jesus.
Jesus is brought before Pilate, for only he can issue a death sentence.
Pilate can find no guilt in Jesus.
To appease the Jews, Pilate has Jesus scourged.
“It was our infirmities that He bore, our sufferings that He endured.”
“He was pierced for our offenses, crushed for our sins.”
“By His stripes we were healed.”

Mysteries.Title:
The Third Sorrowful Mystery

Jesus is crowned
Mysteries.SubTitle: Poverty

Meditation.text: Jesus answers Pilate that He is a king, but His kingdom is not of this world.
In mockery the soldiers place a crown of thorns on His head.
They put a reed in His right hand, a symbol of authority.
They kneel before Him in derision: “Hail, King of the Jews.”
They spit on Him and taking the reed, strike Him on the head.
Pilate presents Jesus to the crowd and says “Behold the Man.”
The crowd shouts: “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!”
Pilate asks: “Shall I crucify your King?”
They respond: “We have no king but Caesar.”
“Though He was harshly treated, He submitted, and opened not His mouth.”

Mysteries.Title:
The Fourth Sorrowful Mystery

Jesus carries his cross.
Mysteries.SubTitle: Humility

Meditation.text: Jesus carries His Cross to Calvary.
“He who does not carry his cross and follow Me, cannot be My disciple.”
“Take My yoke upon you… your souls will find rest.”
“My yoke is easy, and My burden light.”
“He who loses his life for My sake will find it.”
What we suffer now can never compare to the glory that awaits us.
Simon the Cyrenean helps Jesus carry the Cross to Calvary.
“Weep not for Me, but for your children.”
“God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of Christ.”
The worldly person is an “enemy of the Cross of Christ.”

Mysteries.Title:
The Fifth Sorrowful Mystery

Jesus dies on the Cross
Mysteries.SubTitle: Joy in Finding Jesus

Meditation.text: Jesus is nailed to the Cross.
He prays: “Father, forgive them…”
Jesus says to the repentant thief: “This day you will be with Me in paradise.”
Looking down at Mary His Mother, He says: “Woman, there is your son.”
Looking at the beloved disciple, He says: “There is your Mother.”
Jesus endures the terrible torture of the Cross for three hours.
Nature itself seemed in mourning, for darkness covered the earth.
“There is no greater love than this: to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.”
Having completed His redeeming mission, Jesus cried out: “It is finished.”
“Father, into Your hands, I commend My spirit.”
